campaign: Car / bike detailing studios: booking + proof page and Google profile upkeep (Gujarat)
need: Owner-run detailing, coating and PPF studios win customers on Google, Instagram and WhatsApp. The gap must be something we can SEE from outside, literally true today: no working own website; the website button on the Google listing opens a sign-in page, a Linktree or an Instagram profile; the newest 3 Google reviews have no owner reply; a Book Now button with no booking form. Some studios already pay for Meta ads that lead to WhatsApp or a call (a spend signal). Lost bookings are NOT observed: never claim a loss.

need_analysis.summary: Owner-run car/bike detailing, coating and PPF studios in Gujarat win customers through Google Maps, Instagram and WhatsApp, but many have no working own site, a Linktree/Instagram as the website, unanswered reviews, or a Book Now button without a form. We sell a one-page booking and proof page plus Google profile upkeep; the gap has to be visible from outside today.
need_analysis.who_has_this_need: Single-outlet, owner-run detailing / ceramic coating / PPF / bike detailing studios in Mehsana, Kadi, Visnagar, Patan, Palanpur, Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad, then Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara, Anand and Nadiad. They are small (1 to 3 staff), the owner decides alone and answers the studio's published mobile number.
observable_signals: Own website missing, dead, parked, or a Wix/Linktree/Instagram-only page (visible by fetching the studio's own URL)
Website button on the Google listing opens a sign-in page, Linktree or Instagram profile (needs Maps, which is not reachable free today)
Newest 3 Google reviews have no owner reply (Maps only)
Book Now button with no booking form on the studio's own page
Studio is certified/listed by a film or coating brand (Garware Application Studio, Ceramic Pro, XPEL, Llumar), so it is a real, active, premium-priced studio that already pays for brand presence
Phone/WhatsApp number published by the business itself in a brand locator, directory listing or its own page
where_signals_show: Brand installer locators (Garware Hi-Tech Films 'Locate Us' city pages; other film/coating brand locators)
Studio's own site, if any (fetch it to classify: none / Linktree / own site alive / dead / Book Now without form)
Small public directories with phone numbers (carchhe.com, magicpin, IndiaMART service sellers) found by WebSearch per town
Google Maps listing (website button, reviews): blocked to free tools; Apify budget is 0
Meta Ad Library: not reachable without Apify or a browser
disqualifiers: Franchises and multi-outlet brands (CarzSpa, 3M Car Care, Exotic Car Detailing Studio, GoMechanic, Detailing Devils, The Detailing Mafia)
Car dealerships, showrooms, hotels, plain car-wash points, accessory shops
Film/coating dealers and traders that are not studios (for example the dealer rows on the Garware pages: S M Trade Co, Futkar Sales, Global Auto Traders)
Placeholder rows such as the 'Test' entry on the Garware Ahmedabad page

Studios already verified or in our leads list (Krishna Auto Coating, Krishna Xtreme, Detailing Xpert, Walker's, DNX, Motors Inn, Dwarkesh Car Detailing Studio, RRR, Carx Care, Arihant, Exotic, CarzSpa Mehsana)
Phone that only reaches a call centre or portal number, and anything outside the listed geography

chosen.name: Garware and other film/coating brand installer locators, then own-site audit
chosen.how_to_run: Step 1: WebFetch https://www.garwarehitechfilms.com/paint-protection-film/<city> for city in ahmedabad, gandhinagar, vadodara, surat, rajkot, anand, nadiad, mehsana, patan, palanpur (the city slug pattern is confirmed on ahmedabad, surat, rajkot, vadodara). Prompt: list every business in 'Locate Us' with name, address, phone; label rows as 'Garware Application Studio' vs plain dealer/trader. Step 2: WebSearch for other brand locators for Gujarat: 'Ceramic Pro certified installer Ahmedabad', 'Llumar / Gtechniq / Kavaca / Autoglym authorised detailing studio <city>', and keep only single-outlet studios. Step 3: for every kept studio run WebSearch '<studio name> <area> <city>' and WebFetch its own site if one exists; classify website status: none / Instagram only / Linktree / own site alive / dead or parked / sign-in wall; check for a Book Now button without a form. Step 4: drop anything on the already-verified list, any franchise or multi-outlet brand, any dealer or trader, and any 'Test' placeholder row.
chosen.qualifying_signal: Independent single-outlet studio named in a brand locator with a business-published phone, AND own website is absent, Linktree/Instagram, dead/parked, or has Book Now without a booking form (slot a, c or d). Reviews-unanswered (slot b) is recorded as 'unverified' because Maps is not reachable today.
chosen.fields_to_capture: studio name, area, city, phone as published (with the URL where seen), brand locator name, website URL and status, Book Now present with or without form, brand/franchise flag, safe first-message slot, date seen

chosen.name: Per-town WebSearch for studio-owned pages and small directories, with website-state check
chosen.how_to_run: Run WebSearch (standard mode, one town at a time) with these queries, then WebFetch each hit that is a studio's own domain or a directory entry: (1) '<town> car detailing studio ceramic coating PPF' for town in Mehsana, Kadi, Visnagar, Patan, Palanpur, Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara, Anand, Nadiad; (2) '<town> bike detailing ceramic coating studio'; (3) 'business.site car detailing <town>' (dead Google business.site pages mean a dead website button); (4) 'car detailing <area> <city> book now' to find Book Now pages; (5) 'carchhe OR magicpin car detailing <town>' for directory entries with phone. Use blocked_domains carzspa.com, gomechanic.in, write.as, 3mcarcare to cut franchise noise. For each hit fetch the studio's own page: record the phone published there, whether a booking form exists behind Book Now, last blog/offer date (evidence date must come from the page), and whether a separate own domain exists.
chosen.qualifying_signal: Studio with a business-published phone on its own page or claimed directory entry, whose own web presence shows a gap: no own domain (directory/Instagram/Linktree only), dead or parked site, or Book Now with no form. Evidence page URL and a date on the page must exist; no URL means no candidate.
chosen.fields_to_capture: studio name, town, phone with source URL, website status, Book Now with/without form, evidence URL and date, brand/franchise flag, safe first-message slot
chosen.expected_yield: 2 to 4 usable studios; richer in Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot and Vadodara than in Visnagar, Kadi, Palanpur where standard search returned almost nothing.

chosen.name: carchhe.com town listings as a studio roster with published phone
chosen.how_to_run: For each town fetch the category page and its ?page=N pages with WebFetch: https://www.carchhe.com/car-detailing-services/{town}. Working slugs tested today: mehsana (4 pages), gandhinagar (10), palanpur (4), ahmedabad (11), vadodara (11). kadi returned 404. Also try patan, visnagar, anand, nadiad, surat, rajkot in the same URL pattern; skip any that 404. Pages to read first: Mehsana 1-4, Gandhinagar 1-4, Palanpur 1-4 (drop Surat or Ahmedabad rows that sit under Palanpur), Ahmedabad 1-6 (the page 1 rows are mostly top-rated and active), Vadodara 1-4. WebFetch prompt: list each business with name, locality, rating, review count and listing path. Keep a row only if the name or path contains detailing, coating, PPF, ceramic, car spa, studio, wrap or bike detailing. Drop dealers, showrooms, GoMechanic, Toyota, Kia, Tata, garages, plain washing or foam-wash points, accessory shops, and the verified and franchise names. Then open each kept listing at https://www.carchhe.com/car-detailing-service/{town}/{slug} and read the tel: number, address and Maps pin. Keep the number only if it is a mobile (10 digits starting 6-9); mark landline, 080 and 1800 numbers as weak. First kept names from today's pages: Washkr Sola, SHREEJI CAR SPA (Satellite), MP Car spa (Gota), AutoGlow (Chandkheda), Coating Buddies (Odhav), INCREDIBLE CAR DETAILING (Shilaj, Bopal, phone 075670 06633), MotorX Car Care (Makarba), Vampires Detailing (Sola), Caroholics Car Spa Centre (Raysan), VEER CAR ACCESSORIES & CAR DETAILING (Sargasan, 145 reviews), Capital Autozone (Sargasan), Autotech the car detailing studio (Vadodara), GURUKRUPA CAR DECOR AND DETAILING (Vadodara), KD CAR SPA (Manjalpur), Swish Auto Care (Vadodara), Jaitra (Gandhinagar sector 13). Stop at about 40 kept rows.
chosen.qualifying_signal: A single-outlet detailing, coating or PPF studio in the geography that carchhe lists with a rating and review count and a mobile number, and whose listing has no website, Instagram or social field. This makes it fit_only until the own-footprint audit opens a real signal: it never counts as a signal on its own, and no loss is ever claimed.
chosen.fields_to_capture: studio name, town, locality, rating, review count, carchhe listing URL, published phone with the URL where seen, address, whether a website or social field is present (yes/no), single-outlet or multi-outlet flag, rejected-type flag, date fetched (2026-10-30). Review recency and reply status stay empty because carchhe shows neither.
chosen.expected_yield: About 30-40 roster rows with a mobile number, fit_only. Feeds the second source; does not stand alone.

chosen.name: Own-footprint audit of each roster studio (website, Linktree, Instagram-only, free template, booking form)
chosen.how_to_run: For every kept roster name (top priority: studios with 15+ reviews and a 4.5+ rating, since they have trust but a weak path), run WebSearch in standard mode with these exact patterns: (1) "{studio name}" {town} car detailing, (2) "{studio name}" {town} contact booking, (3) "{studio name}" linktr.ee OR grexa.site OR business.site OR wixsite OR godaddysites. Fetch the studio's own URL with WebFetch and classify it as: none found / Instagram only / Linktree / free template (grexa.site, business.site, wixsite, godaddysites, blogspot) / own site alive / dead or parked / sign-in wall. On any live site, read the page for a booking form, a Book Now or Contact button (does it link to # or a bare contact page, or does it open a form), and the footer mobile or WhatsApp number plus any dated post or copyright year. Also add a name-only cross-check on Sulekha: WebFetch https://www.sulekha.com/car-detailing-services/{town} and see if the studio appears with a profile link. Extra small-town queries in the Mehsana, Kadi, Patan and Palanpur belt, using the town plus these words: car detailing studio ceramic coating contact, car polish ceramic coating Gujarati (કાર ડિટેલિંગ મહેસાણા), PPF wrap studio {town} 9, and bike detailing {town}. Before outreach, confirm that the studio really does detailing and is single-outlet (check for other branches on its site). Do not open Instagram or Facebook profiles; use only what search results and the business's own site show.
chosen.qualifying_signal: One of the 4 safe slots, backed by a fetched page with a date or the fetch date: (a) its own site, Linktree or Instagram link is dead, parked, a sign-in wall or the wrong business, (c) no own website found for a studio with 15+ reviews, (d) Book Now or Contact button on its own or template site with no booking form or a link to #. Slot (b) (newest 3 reviews unanswered) cannot be opened without Maps and is left empty. Free-template pages (grexa.site and similar) count as a signal because the studio has no site of its own.
chosen.fields_to_capture: studio name, signal slot (a, c or d), website status class, own-site URL, evidence quote or element (for example Book Now links to #), date seen or the page's own date, owner or WhatsApp mobile published on the own site with the URL, single-outlet flag, one-line reason it is not a franchise, confidence (signal confirmed vs fit_only).
chosen.expected_yield: From 30-40 roster names, expect 8-12 with a classifiable footprint and 4-8 usable with a slot (c or d most often), which is close to the target of about 8 across both rounds.

plan_round2.if_low_yield: 1) Widen the roster: fetch further carchhe pages (Ahmedabad 7-11, Vadodara 5-11, Gandhinagar 5-10) and try carchhe slugs for patan, visnagar, anand, nadiad, surat, rajkot, then use the Sulekha town pages as a cross-check for the same towns. 2) If most roster names have no findable site, treat 'no own site found for a studio with 15+ reviews' as slot c but label it fit_only, and ask the owner to approve a short Maps check instead. 3) Maps is still the missing link: ask the owner to turn on Claude in Chrome so the Maps pages of the top 15 studios can be opened read-only for the website button and last 3 review replies, or to approve a one-off Apify top-up capped at about US$0.5 (one Google Maps places run, 30 detailing studios across the first-tier towns, with the website and review-reply fields). 4) Re-check the earlier open items once a browser works: Detailing Dude (Surat), A2Z Car Detailing Studio (Bodakdev) and Akshar Car Spa (Vadodara). 5) Last resort: query by product brand pages that small studios link to, for example site pages mentioning 'authorised applicator' plus a Gujarat town."}]

judged.replan_advice: Only 2 usable leads (Kesari Custom, Quartz Detailing Studio), below the 5 needed. Cause: the free tools cannot see the signals that matter (Maps website button, newest 3 reviews and replies, ad status). carchhe and Garware pages give only name, rating and phone, so 11 rows stay fit_only. Next round: (1) Search for the gap directly instead of the directory. Run WebSearch and WebFetch on 'grexa.site car detailing', 'grexa.site ceramic coating', 'grexa.site PPF' with town names, and also linktr.ee, business.site, wixsite, godaddysites, mystrikingly and 'site.google.com' plus detailing. The Grexa template search was the only query that produced opened-page signals. Open the Garware 'Test' placeholder-style neighbours and Kesari-type pages one by one. (2) DNS and fetch check the websites of roster studios found in directories, to find dead or parked domains like Quartz (a cheap and fully free test). Candidates: Detailing Dude-type brands with a domain listed on Justdial/Sulekha snippets. (3) Check the two dropped studios with real signals, Autokrafte (no booking form, site poorly kept) and Sunshine Autochem (grexa template, active blog), against the real lead database. If they are not in it, restore them as signal_only, which would bring usable to 4. (4) Widen geography to Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara, Anand and Nadiad using Grexa and free-template queries, since Kadi, Visnagar, Patan, Palanpur and Gandhinagar returned almost nothing from free search. (5) Ask the owner whether a small, capped Apify run (Google Maps scraper with website, reviews and review-reply fields) is allowed later, because only Maps data can confirm slots a, b and c. Without it, expect fit_only rows. (6) Treat carchhe as a phone and name roster only; do not count its 'no website' field as a signal.
